title: HireBeat: recruitment & job matching
summary: Candidate-matching engine and automated job workflows across many data sources.
impact: 45% better matching accuracy and lower API latency.
problem: The platform needed advanced job matching and automated candidate workflows across many constantly updating data sources.
solution: Developed a candidate-matching engine and automated job workflows using Python and Node.js services, with optimised search and filtering and streamlined data integration pipelines.
result: Improved job-matching accuracy and cut API latency by 45%, raising user satisfaction.
